items.detail: M172, kitchen specification, island decision and selected-D are fingerprinted.
Every upstream source fingerprint recorded by M172 still matches the repository.
Selected-D source hash remains the protected baseline.
Study uses the owner-directed 14 x 12 ft / 168 sf kitchen target.
The 12 ft 6 in source module run leaves 18 in total reserve along the 14 ft clear axis.
The 8 x 4 ft reference exceeds both the 12-ft clear cross-section and the 14-ft end-span when using the specified 42-in proxies.
A derived 7 x 3 ft test island fits the 14 x 12 ft clear rectangle exactly with 42-in proxies and a 24-in body plus 12-in overhang.
A derived 6 x 3 ft test island leaves 12 in total end reserve; the cross-section remains exact.
18-in cabinet body is not accepted as a fit because it conflicts with the documented 24-in body depth.
Only bounded alternatives are reported; no owner-selected dimensions or design status are changed.
